privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Advisor Prep Hero is local-first. Your files, your AI prompts, and your account keys never leave your machine. Any opt-ins below are the only data Advisor Prep Hero ever collects, and all default to off.

design-partner.title: Optional error reporting
design-partner.description: You are among the first advisors using Advisor Prep Hero in practice. With this on, Advisor Prep Hero sends structured usage counts only: which features you use and where you get stuck. Never your content, file names, client names, or prompts. Off by default; turn it off any time.
design-partner.field-features: Which features you used: ask, workflow, search, email import. A count only, not what you asked.
design-partner.field-workflow-id: Which workflow template you ran (the template id, not the output).
design-partner.field-search-count: How many searches you ran. No query text.
design-partner.field-install-id: Your anonymous install id plus app version and platform.
design-partner.endpoint-note: Endpoint: forms.lanternplatform.app/api/forms/keepance/design-partner-event. Used only to improve the product for your practice.

telemetry.title: Anonymous usage stats
telemetry.description: Help improve Advisor Prep Hero by sending lifecycle events: app launches, trial start, trial end, license activated, license deactivated. No content, no files, no AI prompts, no email.
telemetry.field-install-id: <c>install_id</c>: a random UUID generated on this machine (visible below). Not tied to your email or license.
telemetry.field-app-version: <c>app_version</c>, <c>platform</c>: which build of Advisor Prep Hero, and macOS / Windows / Linux.
telemetry.endpoint-note: Endpoint: <c>forms.lanternplatform.app/api/forms/keepance/app-event</c>. JSONL stored on Advisor Prep Hero's server. Used only for funnel metrics and roadmap decisions.

email.title: Email updates
email.intro: If you opted into email updates at first launch (or via the website), you'll get launch announcements and discount codes. No drip campaigns, no weekly newsletters.
email.unsub: To remove yourself from the list, reply <c>UNSUB</c> to any Advisor Prep Hero email. All replies go straight to support.

data-map.title: Where your data lives and who can see it
data-map.description: A plain-English map of what stays on your machine, what is sent to your AI provider, and what Advisor Prep Hero’s own servers see (only a license check). You can print it or save it as a PDF to show a client.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.description: Expose your Advisor Prep Hero workspace to any MCP-compatible AI client. Install once, then ask Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any other client about your notes, chats, and memory facts without copy-pasting.

mcp.disabled-title: MCP is off: network lockdown is on
mcp.disabled-body: While a client with network lockdown is active (or On this computer only is selected), MCP servers are disabled so confidential work cannot leave your machine through an outside AI client. Any write an MCP client attempts is blocked and recorded in your audit log. Turn off network lockdown to use MCP again.

install.heading: How to install:
install.step-download: Click Download .mcpb above to copy the bundle path to your clipboard.
install.step-config: Open Settings, Developer, Edit Config, or drag the .mcpb file into the Claude Desktop window.
install.step-pick-folder: When prompted for a workspace folder, pick the same folder you opened in Advisor Prep Hero.
install.after-install: After install, ask Claude "search my Advisor Prep Hero workspace for X" or "read notes/plan.md" and watch it work.

ollama.recommended-model: Recommended first model: <c>llama3.2:3b</c> (about 2 GB, runs on almost any laptop).

welcome.title: Welcome to Advisor Prep Hero
welcome.subtitle: The private place your practice lives, that answers you back.
welcome.body-1: Advisor Prep Hero keeps your clients' files, documents, and email on your own machine. Ask a question across your whole practice and get back a cited answer you can verify. Your files stay real files in a folder you control.
welcome.body-2: Setup takes about 2 minutes. I'll help you pick a folder for your work, connect your AI provider account (optional), and run your first workflow.
welcome.step-1: Step 1. Pick a folder for your work
welcome.step-2: Step 2. Connect your AI provider account (optional)

workspace.title: Pick a folder for your work
workspace.subtitle: Your client files stay on your machine, in a folder you control.
workspace.body-1: This is where your client work will live: real Word documents, PDFs, and notes in a normal folder on your hard drive. Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Pick a location that's easy to find and easy to back up.
workspace.body-2: Pro tip: a folder inside Dropbox, iCloud, or OneDrive syncs across devices, but that also means your files sit with that provider. For client-confidential work, keep the folder local.
workspace.body-3: The next screen will let you actually pick the folder. For now, just confirm you understand what we're about to ask.

apikey.title: Add an AI provider key
apikey.subtitle: Optional, but you'll need one to use the AI features.
apikey.body-1: Advisor Prep Hero is a "bring your own key" tool. You sign up with an AI provider directly and paste their account key here. Your keys are stored in your operating system's secure keychain and never leave your computer.
apikey.body-2: The fastest way to get started is with <s>Anthropic Claude</s>:
apikey.step-signup: Sign up (free, $5 in credits to start)
apikey.step-copy-key: Copy the key (starts with <c>sk-ant-</c>) and paste it below
apikey.skip-hint: You can skip this and add a key later in Settings, AI Account Keys.

demo.title: Run your first workflow
demo.subtitle: See a real deliverable come together in seconds.
demo.body-1: The fastest way to see what Advisor Prep Hero does is to run a workflow. Pick any template from the Workflows tab, answer the questions it asks, and watch it produce a finished Word document in your folder.
demo.step-2: Pick any template that fits your practice
demo.outcome: You'll get back finished work as real Word documents, ready to open, edit, and send to clients.
demo.populate-toggle: Add {{count}} sample client files to get started
demo.populate-help: Adds finished examples so you can see what a completed workflow looks like before running your first real project. You can delete them any time.
demo.copy-error: Could not copy samples: {{error}}. Don't worry, you're still in.

disk-encryption.title: One thing to check: your disk encryption
disk-encryption.body: Advisor Prep Hero keeps your documents as normal files in your workspace folder, on your machine. If the laptop is lost or stolen, your operating system's full-disk encryption is what protects them. It takes a minute to confirm it is on.
disk-encryption.check-windows: Windows: Settings, then Privacy & security, then Device encryption (or search for BitLocker). It should say On.
disk-encryption.check-macos: Mac: System Settings, then Privacy & Security, then FileVault. It should say FileVault is turned on.
disk-encryption.check-linux: Linux: most installers offer LUKS full-disk encryption. Check your distribution's disk settings, or run lsblk and look for a crypt entry.

api-key-card.title: Next step: add your AI account key
api-key-card.description: Advisor Prep Hero uses your own account key from Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google, so your AI usage goes straight to your provider with no markup from us. Your Advisor Prep Hero plan covers the software.
api-key-card.keys-local: Account keys are stored locally on your computer. Never sent to us.

step-1.body: Click the button below to open <s>{{dashboard}}</s> in your browser. You'll need to sign in (or sign up) to get to the keys page.

step-2-ollama.body: Download Ollama for your OS, then in a terminal run <c>ollama pull llama3.2</c> (or any model you want). Advisor Prep Hero auto-detects Ollama on the next step.

scope.answer-matter-title: This answer was confined to the active client. Other clients' data was not searched.
scope.answer-all-matters-title: This answer searched across every client (cross-client mode).

citation.unverified-warning: One or more citations could not be verified against the source. Open the source to confirm before relying on it.

sidebar.key-pending: Waiting for your firm admin to grant this device access to this client. I'll open it automatically once they do.

manager.title: Clients
manager.description: A client groups one client's work under one or more workspace folders. Files in a client's folders are scoped to that client so other clients' data never appears.
manager.client-name-helper: Optional. The company or organization this client belongs to, if any.
manager.empty: No clients yet. Create your first client above.
manager.no-folders: Open a workspace to map folders to this client.
manager.no-mail-accounts: Connect an email account in Settings to map it to this client.
manager.mail-account-hint: Email from a mapped account is scoped to this client.
manager.privileged-hint: When this client is active, network plugins and MCP servers are turned off so nothing can leave your machine through an extension. Unrelated to email sensitivity tagging.
manager.mcp-access-label: Allow connected external AI tools to access this client's files
manager.mcp-access-hint: Off by default. Turning this on lets external AI tools connected to Advisor Prep Hero (via the MCP protocol) read this client's files, even when another client is active.
manager.firm-share-action: Share this client with my firm
manager.firm-leave-hint: This removes the firm link. Your local files stay on your machine.
manager.firm-leave-confirm: Stop sharing this client with my firm? My local files stay on my machine.
manager.firm-invite-new-user-hint: This email is not in your org yet. I'll create their account and show you a temporary password to share with them.
manager.firm-temp-password-hint: This is the only time this password is shown. Copy it now.
manager.firm-remove-member-confirm: Remove {{email}} from this client? Their key access will be rotated.
manager.firm-key-blocked: Waiting for your firm admin to grant this device access to this client. I'll open it automatically once they do.
manager.firm-invite-user-exists: {{email}} already has an account. Use the admin console to add them, or ask them to accept an invitation.
manager.isolated-confirm-body: Network lockdown blocks all network-capable plugins and MCP servers while this client is active. AI requests stay on this computer; nothing can leave through an extension. You can turn this off at any time.
manager.isolated-affirmation: This client is now isolated. AI requests stay on this computer, and outside network connections are blocked so nothing can leave this client.
manager.isolated-off-hint: Network lockdown turned off for this client.

notes.title: Shared notes
notes.subtitle: Everyone on this client sees these notes. They sync live.
notes.no-access: Waiting for your firm admin to grant this device access.
notes.no-access-hint: I'll open these notes automatically once your admin publishes the key to this device.
notes.sent-to-wealthbox: Added to the Wealthbox review card on this client's map

book.empty: No clients yet. Add a client to see your whole book here.
book.subtitle: Every client, ranked by who needs attention: how complete their Client Map is and how long since it was touched.

beneficiary.review-note: Flagged for your review. Not legal advice.

signin.solo-notice: Sign in to your firm to activate a seat and collaborate on shared clients. Solo use needs no account and stays fully local.
signin.just-bought-link: I just bought Advisor Prep Hero Firm

claim.heading: Claim your firm
claim.description: I received a license key from LemonSqueezy after purchasing. I'll use it to create my admin account and activate my firm.
claim.error-already-claimed: This license key has already been claimed. Sign in with your existing account.
claim.error-not-found: I don't recognize that license key. Check the email from LemonSqueezy and try again.
claim.success-heading: Firm claimed. Activate your seat next.
claim.success-hint: I've pre-filled your license key. Enter a label for this device and click Activate seat.

admin.title: Firm console
admin.not-admin: The firm console is available to administrators. Ask your firm admin to create clients and manage seats.
admin.invite-new-user-hint: This email is not in your org yet. I'll create their account and show you a temporary password to share.
admin.temp-password-hint: This is shown once. Copy and share it with {{email}} directly.
admin.assured-description: Store a managed provider key so members can use the Assured (zero-retention proxy) confidentiality mode. The key is encrypted at rest on the server and never shown again.
admin.republish-keys-action: Re-publish keys to all member devices
admin.republish-keys-ok: Keys sent to all registered devices.
admin.invite-user-exists: {{email}} already has an account. Use the admin console to add them, or ask them to accept an invitation.
admin.wall-user-not-found: No user ID found for {{email}}. Invite them first so their ID is cached.
admin.auto-republish-ok: Granted key access to newly registered devices for {{count}} client(s).

sso.description: Let firm members sign in through your organization's identity provider. Register this application with your IdP using the Redirect URI below, then enter the credentials your IdP gives you.
sso.redirect-uri-hint: Paste this URI into your IdP when registering the application.
sso.provider-hint-entra: Register in Azure portal → App registrations → Redirect URIs.
sso.provider-hint-google: Register in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.
sso.provider-hint-generic: Register the redirect URI with your OIDC-compatible identity provider.
sso.secret-saved-hint: Secret saved. Leave blank to keep the existing secret.

carry.heading: Bring your clients into the firm
carry.intro: For each client, choose to leave it private (stays just on your computer) or share it with the firm so colleagues can collaborate. Sharing moves the shared notes and any documents you co-edit, all encrypted. Your files, email, and search index stay on your computer.
carry.empty: You have no clients to bring over yet. You can share any client later from the client screen.
carry.privileged-confirm-body: Sharing turns on encrypted internet sync for this privileged client so colleagues can collaborate. The relay only ever stores encrypted data it cannot read. Continue?

bridge.heading: Use Advisor Prep Hero with your firm
bridge.intro: Pick how you want to get into a firm. Then you can bring your existing clients over, choosing for each one whether to keep it private or share it with colleagues.
bridge.door-create-body: You become the admin and the first seat. Invite colleagues, share clients, set up single sign-on and the firm security.
bridge.door-join-body: Sign in to a firm that already exists and claim your seat. An admin sets you up first.
bridge.create-paid-note: The firm plan is a paid plan, separate from your solo license. Get it here, then claim your firm below:

prompt.title: Use Advisor Prep Hero with your firm
prompt.body: Bring colleagues in and share clients, or join a firm that already uses Advisor Prep Hero. Your private clients stay private.

local.label: On your machine. No cloud AI
local.note: This runs on a local model ({{provider}}). No AI prompt or file is sent to a cloud AI.

direct.label: Sent to your {{provider}} account
direct.note: Sent straight from your machine to {{provider}} with your own account key. Advisor Prep Hero is not in between. {{provider}} receives the prompt and may keep it briefly for abuse monitoring; control training opt-out in your {{provider}} account.

demo.label: Browser demo. Do not use with client data
demo.note: In this online demo, messages pass through a shared Advisor Prep Hero relay. The desktop app never does this. Do not enter confidential or client information here.

checking.label: Checking AI destination
checking.note: Advisor Prep Hero is confirming where this request will go before sending.

none.label: No AI connected
none.note: Connect an AI provider to start getting answers.

privileged-matter.badge: Isolated client: outside connections are blocked so nothing can leave this client.
privileged-matter.title-manual: Network lockdown: network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.
privileged-matter.title-privileged-matter: On because the active client has network lockdown. Network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.
privileged-matter.title-local-only: On because On this computer only is selected. Network plugins and MCP servers are disabled.

viewer.privilege-note: Excluded from AI retrieval by default. The Include sensitive content toggle in chat is the only way to bring it back in.

control.on-body: This workspace's files are encrypted at rest. Advisor Prep Hero decrypts them transparently, so your work is unchanged.
control.locked-note: This vault is locked. Reopen the workspace to unlock it with your recovery phrase.

ceremony.cannot-recover-warning: Advisor Prep Hero cannot recover this for you. If you lose this phrase and your device's keychain, your encrypted files will be permanently inaccessible.
ceremony.confirm-prompt: Confirm you've saved the phrase. Enter the words at these positions:

enable.title: Encrypt this workspace
enable.subtitle: AES-256 at rest, transparent in Advisor Prep Hero
enable.detail: When enabled, every document file in this workspace is stored as ciphertext on disk. Advisor Prep Hero decrypts them transparently so your workflow is unchanged.
enable.bullet-names-visible: File names and folder structure remain visible
enable.bullet-phrase-once: A 24-word recovery phrase is generated once. You must save it.
enable.bullet-no-recovery: If you lose the phrase and the keychain, files cannot be recovered
enable.bullet-firm-escrow: A firm admin can recover this vault via escrow
enable.ceremony-subheading: Write it down somewhere safe. Shown once only.
enable.escrow-notice: A firm admin will be able to recover this vault on your behalf using the firm's escrow key. This is in addition to your personal recovery phrase.
enable.encrypting-subtitle: This may take a moment for large workspaces.
enable.done-subtitle: All files are now protected at rest.

locked.title: Vault locked
locked.subtitle: This workspace is encrypted and the key is not on this machine.
locked.explanation: Enter your 24-word recovery phrase to unlock this vault. Advisor Prep Hero will restore the key to your keychain so you can open this workspace normally from now on.
locked.phrase-hint: Recovery phrases are 24 words separated by spaces.
locked.escape-hatch: Turn off vault and decrypt files
locked.error-invalid-phrase: That phrase has an invalid format. Check each word and try again.
locked.error-recovery-failed: That phrase is valid, but it does not match this vault. Make sure you are using the correct recovery phrase.

escape-hatch.title: Decrypt this workspace and turn off the vault
escape-hatch.description: This will convert every encrypted file back to a normal, unencrypted file on this disk. The vault will be disabled and removed from this workspace.
escape-hatch.warning-title: After this, at-rest protection reverts to OS disk encryption only.
escape-hatch.warning-body: Your files will be readable by any process that has access to this folder. Make sure your operating system's full-disk encryption is enabled if you handle sensitive documents.
escape-hatch.working: Decrypting files... this may take a moment for large workspaces.
escape-hatch.done-message: All files have been decrypted and the vault has been removed. Your files are normal unencrypted files on disk.
